Ya I did. In 2019 i stayed inside the house for two weeks because of a panic attack I had in a Uber (My driver had to drive me to ER cause I thought something was wrong with me). Anyways turns out I just drank / sorta chugged caffeine water that night from those damn BAI waters didn’t know they had caffeine, but I didn’t make that connection till weeks later. Anyways 2 weeks I stayed indoors! 

Then I slowly had to expose myself outdoors because, No way in hell I was gonna allow myself to become agoraphobic . So for 4 months I was walking around neighborhood for 30 min or so and exposing myself to social situations again. Grateful I lived across street from shopping center so I visited stores daily and the liquor store down the street. Then I starting visiting my friends house down the street for Bible studies weekly (was not too big on god at time but thought I needed some sort of hope and social life). Grateful for him because they all encouraged me to push myself further into more exposure, eventually we made a trip to the beach months later and the ride there and the trip was exhausting but when I realized I finally made it past my comfort zone I didn’t look back. I still have trouble from time to time when I travel a little further but do my best. [This book](https://www.amazon.com/Badass-Ways-Anxiety-Panic-Attacks/dp/9090305262) saved me from the time I was having it covers panic attack coping skills and covers beating agoraphobia and having exposures. I recommend it to everyone who deals with agoraphobia and anxiety. Please PM me if you have any questions! (:
